acceptance_criteria: "Eigenen Begriff anlegen" takes a word and a sentence with the same cleaning and German refusals as rewording; saving writes a generated id (never derived from the label) and puts it at the end of the board
If the entry was written but the board write failed, the concept is listed under own concepts not on the board and can be added from there
Own concepts can be moved and taken off the board like catalogue concepts; taken off, they stay listed as own concepts and can be added back
"Endgültig löschen" for an own concept needs a confirmation and removes it from board and profile; entries a newer app wrote are never offered for deletion
listCustomConcepts reports the damage kind of unreadable ids, and the 500-id cap counts ids that cannot be shown
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: In the caregiver area a caregiver creates a concept of their own (word and spoken sentence), it goes onto the board of the edited profile, can be moved, taken off, put back and deleted for good after a confirmation; the child's board shows and speaks it.
